|rulings=* Suspending [[Ominous Rumors]] will flip [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost{{!}}Endor Operations]] from the 7-side to the 0-side. When [[Ominous Rumors]] is restored to normal (at end of turn), [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost{{!}}Endor Operations]] will flip back to the 7-side if the conditions are met.<ref name="scomp" />
* [[General Crix Madine (V)]] is an optional response that occurs during the response step of playing this Interrupt (before the result). Dark gets first response to Light's action, and if Dark cancels this Interrupt first, then Madine cannot respond to it.
* Lost function: If [[General Crix Madine (V)]] is on table, first Light loses 1 Force to pay the cost, then Dark has a chance to respond (e.g. with [[Sense]]), then (if not canceled) Light may respond such as with [[General Crix Madine (V)]]'s retrieval. Once there are no further responses, the Interrupt has its result and places itself out of play.
* Lost function: If canceled (e.g. by [[Sense]]) then this Interrupt does not place itself out of play.
* Lost function: If played successfully (e.g. not canceled by [[Sense]]), this card never actually reaches the Lost Pile but instead goes straight out of play.
